name: mermaid-diagram-lens
description: View your Mermaid diagrams with independent theming, exports, and focused previews.

commands.title: Mermaid Viewer: Open Preview to the Side
Mermaid Viewer: Open Preview in New Window

mermaidViewer.useVSCodeTheme.description: Automatically sync Mermaid theme with VSCode theme (dark/light)

mermaidViewer.autoRefresh.description: Automatically refresh preview on document changes

mermaidViewer.refreshDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before refreshing preview after changes

enumDescriptions: Match VS Code's current color theme
Always use the light preview chrome
Always use the dark preview chrome
mermaidViewer.previewAppearance.description: Appearance of the preview chrome regardless of VS Code theme

mermaidViewer.panelTitleStyle.description: Style of the preview panel title

mermaidViewer.renderTimeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for a diagram to render (0 = no timeout, allows unlimited rendering time for large diagrams)

mermaidViewer.copy.includeFrontMatter.description: Include frontmatter when copying Mermaid code from standalone .mmd/.mermaid files

enumDescriptions: Open preview in a new floating window
mermaidViewer.defaultPreviewLocation.description: Where the toolbar icon opens the Mermaid preview. Individual commands are always available in the Command Palette.

mermaidViewer.copy.wrapper.patternErrorMessage: Wrapper must contain {{mermaid-code}} as the placeholder for the diagram code (e.g. :::mermaid\n{{mermaid-code}}\n:::)

mermaidViewer.format.diagnostics.description: Highlight unformatted Mermaid diagram lines with a warning squiggle and a lightbulb (Quick Fix) to fix them one at a time.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run -S esbuild-base -- --minify && npm run esbuild-loader -- --minify && npm run copy-mermaid && npm run copy-codicons
scripts.esbuild: npm run -S esbuild-base -- --sourcemap && npm run esbuild-loader -- --sourcemap && npm run copy-mermaid && npm run copy-codicons
scripts.esbuild-watch: npm run -S esbuild-base -- --sourcemap --watch & npm run esbuild-loader -- --sourcemap --watch && npm run copy-mermaid
scripts.copy-mermaid: shx rm -rf out/mermaid && shx mkdir -p out/mermaid/dist/chunks && shx cp node_modules/mermaid/dist/mermaid.esm.min.mjs out/mermaid/dist/ && shx cp -r node_modules/mermaid/dist/chunks/mermaid.esm.min out/mermaid/dist/chunks/ && shx rm -rf out/mermaid-layout-elk && shx mkdir -p out/mermaid-layout-elk/dist/chunks && shx cp node_modules/@mermaid-js/layout-elk/dist/mermaid-layout-elk.esm.min.mjs out/mermaid-layout-elk/dist/ && shx cp -r node_modules/@mermaid-js/layout-elk/dist/chunks/mermaid-layout-elk.esm.min out/mermaid-layout-elk/dist/chunks/
scripts.copy-codicons: shx rm -rf out/codicons && shx mkdir -p out/codicons && shx cp node_modules/@vscode/codicons/dist/codicon.css out/codicons/ && shx cp node_modules/@vscode/codicons/dist/codicon.ttf out/codicons/
scripts.check: npm run compile && npm run lint
